name: New York
h1: AI Interior Design for New York City Apartments
intro: In a city where space is at a premium, New York interior design is all about maximizing every square inch. From historic brownstones to sleek high-rise condos, our AI helps you create functional and stylish urban living spaces.
styleDesc: Exposed brick, metal accents, and open floor plans pay homage to the city's rich manufacturing history while providing a modern, airy feel.
challenge: Maximizing vertical storage in small, narrow rooms with limited natural light.

name: Los Angeles
h1: AI Interior Design for Los Angeles Homes
intro: Embrace the indoor-outdoor California lifestyle with designs tailored for Los Angeles. Whether you live in a mid-century modern home in the hills or a breezy beach house, our AI brings your vision to life.
styleDesc: Clean lines, organic curves, and large glass windows perfectly frame the LA sunshine and natural landscapes.
challenge: Balancing natural cooling and light optimization during intense summer heat.

name: Austin
h1: AI Interior Design Tailored for Austin
intro: Austin's booming real estate market demands a blend of modern innovation and classic Texas charm. Design your perfect space to reflect the city's vibrant, eclectic energy.
styleDesc: A perfect blend of rustic comfort and sleek contemporary lines, ideal for spacious Texas homes.
challenge: Designing open-concept spaces that remain cozy and cohesive.
